shots.card:
Getting paid on-chain
means publishing
your salary.

shots.caption: Sage is an AI agent that checks someone's work and pays them for it. Every payout here is real USDC on mainnet.

shots.card:
Private on Starknet
when you ask.

shots.caption: A founder says the work once. Sage compiles it into milestones and a verification contract.
The rail is Starknet. A Cairo vault holds the money; the amount is not even an argument the agent can pass.
A worker submits. Sage judges the evidence itself and the vault releases the reward — no human in the loop.
The money never touches the worker's wallet. It is escrowed behind a Poseidon commitment; only the worker's secret opens it.
They collect through the STRK20 pool into a shielded note. The receipt is public. Their balance is not.

shots.card:
Auditable in aggregate.
Private in the destination.

shots.caption: Privacy without accountability is a farm. This one took ten of ten slots with twelve wallets — drawn from the chain.
So public work asks for one proof of personhood, once. The cap counts the person, not the address.
Fund it once and the agent decides what work to buy next — where, never how much — and proposes it before a dollar leaves.
